title: Stop parse_quantity withholding unambiguous no-space compact decimal data units (500MB, 512KB)
objective: parse_quantity (apps/api/app/publish/revalidate.py) withholds no-space compact quantities whose unit begins with a magnitude letter. Rule 1: the numeric token greedily consumes a trailing K/M/B, so 500MB becomes magnitude 500M + B and the reassembled MB is rejected. But for KB/MB the two readings (amount=500, unit=MB) and (amount=500000000, unit=B) are the SAME decimal quantity (kilo=1e3, mega=1e6 are decimal prefixes), so withholding is unjustified. This slice makes the value-equivalent decimal data units KB and MB parse while keeping every genuinely ambiguous form failing closed.
in_scope: Add _UNAMBIGUOUS_MAGNITUDE_UNITS = frozenset({KB,MB}) and accept it in _is_supported_compact_unit consumed-magnitude branch.
Update tests/unit/test_publish_revalidate.py: move 10MB/10KB out of fails-closed lists; add positive pins (500MB,512KB,1MB,1KB,1.5MB) and an over-widening control.
Refresh docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/DATA_MODEL.md parser-boundary prose and the stale github_packages_billing pivot comment.
out_of_scope: Rule 2 (binary units KiB/MiB/GiB) - deliberate and out of scope; reported as a separate recommendation.
Changing the github_packages_billing pivot behaviour or publishing the Storage column.
Editing ci.yml, feature_list.json, package-lock.json, scripts/check_urls.py, tests/unit/test_url_allowlist.py, .secrets.baseline.
acceptance_criteria: 10 K, 2GiB, 750MiB, 10MiB, 10KiB, 10MM, 10KK, 10Kfoo, 10Mfoo, 10Brequests, 10Krequests, signs, multi-number, invalid-suffix forms all still fail closed.
